conflicts.topic: E07 current 3-anchor fitment versus affected 2025 vehicles
conflicts.currentSpecification: 3 child-seat anchors, 2 ISOFIX positions, both trims
conflicts.recall: REC-006560 / DRT-001, published 2026-03-10: 218 Deepal SC6501 vehicles year2025, all variants in affected VIN set; possible missing middle rear child-restraint anchor
conflicts.resolution: Check delivered VIN and rectification. Current brochure does not prove retrofit on earlier inventory. VIN CSV could not be downloaded; no claim that any stock VIN above is affected or cleared

conflicts.topic: Dealer year labels versus formal MY
conflicts.resolution: S07 explicit MY24 title coexists with2025 year; E07 AWD explicit MY25 title coexists with2026 year. Do not normalize calendar/build fields into formal MY.

methodology: Official current AU product pages and linked technical brochures control equipment and technical rows
PDF pages are one-indexed including cover; exact row and variant column supplied for all technical/fitment facts
Document dates and printed MY codes visually reviewed; file creation dates are not build dates
HTTP200 alone is never evidence of available NEW stock; inspect body for SOLD and final redirect target
Cached web detail that conflicts with fresh direct body is rejected for availability
NEW advertisements prove advertised condition only, not possession, immediate delivery, factory order acceptance or recall rectification
No dealer outreach, account actions, submitted forms, or app edits
